plain_text:
Growth in climate action has varied widely across regions and countries (Figure 3.3 ). Most OECD
countries – particularly those in Western Europe, Oceania, East Asia, as well as Israel and Canada –
achieved the strongest increases. Eastern European countries and Türkiye also made steady progress,
albeit at a slower pace. In contrast, some regions recorded more uneven advances, with a few countries
emerging as regional leaders. For instance, Chile, Costa Rica, and Mexico led progress in the Latin
America and the Caribbean (LAC) region, whereas South Africa, Singapore and Indonesia stood out in
Africa and Southeast Asia, respectively.
